Can I export my data from the app?

Yes, absolutely, and it's easier than you might think! Your financial data belongs to you, and we make it simple to take it with you. You can export your transactions in two popular formats: CSV, which opens right up in Excel, Google Sheets, or Numbers, and JSON, which is perfect if you want to use your data in other apps or tools.

Exports are lightning-fast, too. Even if you have 10,000 transactions, your export finishes in under 2 minutes. No waiting around, no headaches!

Best of all, exporting is included on our free plan, so you never have to upgrade just to access your own records. Whether you're switching budgeting tools, backing up your history, or diving into your spending with a spreadsheet, your data is always ready when you are. Happy exporting!
